series.title: The Deck
series.sub: Your apps, people and tools, one swipe in from the bar

steps.title: Swipe in from the tab
steps.text: Swipe from the Dock toward the middle of the screen. Out slides the Deck: your people, your apps and your tools.

steps.title: Tap a tile
steps.text: Some tiles act at once. Flashlight switches the torch on, and its tile lights up.

steps.title: Or open a card
steps.text: Others open a card beside the strip. Volume has sliders for media, ringtone and alarm.

steps.title: Start a timer
steps.text: Tap Timer, pick a length and Start. It keeps counting after the Deck closes.

steps.title: Close it
steps.text: Tap anywhere outside, or press Back. Left alone, it closes itself after 10 seconds.

steps.title: Open the Deck settings
steps.text: In Gesture Volume, under Advanced features, tap Deck.

steps.title: Turn tiles on or off
steps.text: Tap Deck tiles and switch on the ones you want. Coin toss and Dice start off; Screenshot can go.

steps.title: Add people to call
steps.text: Back on the Deck screen, Quick dial puts people in the strip: one tap calls them or opens a message.

steps.title: Toss a coin
steps.text: Coin toss now waits at the end of the strip: scroll down to it, tap it, then tap the coin.
